Use `snl library tree` to inspect the resolved Entry hierarchy and numbering of one Library.

### Agent procedure
1. Supply the exact Library slug and request the locale/projection needed by the task.
2. Use the complete tree to review semantic placement, duplicates, and omissions; do not treat a truncated display as graph authority.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl library tree` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
